description: This file contains unit tests for the DeviceHandler class in an Android application, verifying various device-related data handling functions including device info, status, permissions, SMS capabilities, and device health.

classes.name: DeviceHandlerTest
classes.description: A test suite class for verifying the behavior of the DeviceHandler in various scenarios.

methods.name: handleDeviceInfo_returnsStablePayload
methods.description: Tests the handleDeviceInfo method of DeviceHandler, verifying that it returns a payload with expected device info.

methods.name: handleDeviceStatus_returnsExpectedShape
methods.description: Verifies the shape and content of the device status payload returned by handleDeviceStatus.

methods.name: handleDevicePermissions_returnsExpectedShape
methods.description: Checks that handleDevicePermissions returns a permissions payload with correct structure and permission statuses.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsSendOnlyPartialGrantAsGranted
methods.description: Tests that the SMS capability handling treats send-only partial grants as sufficient for granting.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsReadOnlyPartialGrantAsGranted
methods.description: Tests that the SMS capability handling treats read-only partial grants as sufficient for granting.

methods.name: handleDeviceHealth_returnsExpectedShape
methods.description: Verifies the structure and key values in the device health payload.
